economic_hypothesis: The tradable subset is not generic late-day strength. It is fresh price discovery: a stock that was not already extended receives an industry-confirmed morning demand impulse, then follows a directionally efficient path with meaningful afternoon participation while the cross-section is dispersed enough for stock-specific repricing. Requiring at least two independent confirmations avoids treating any one noisy proxy as participant identity.
failure_hypothesis: V4 fails when an opening impulse becomes late-day exhaustion and the next-day loss is large relative to the fixed 15 percent target. The primary diagnostic asks whether freshness, path efficiency, persistent afternoon participation, and cross-sectional opportunity state jointly reduce morning-low failures without collapsing signal count.
